---
title: "Organisational Chart — Current Structure (Authoritative)"
---

*Authoritative current organisational structure (2026). Suits **ISYS6018** (security accountability & segregation of duties), **ISYS2002 / ISAD5001** (stakeholder mapping), and **ISYS6020** (executive decision authority). Reviewed 29-06-2026.*

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This is the **current, authoritative** org chart for CloudCore Networks. It reflects the post-2023 executive structure: a single CEO with five C-suite direct reports (CTO, CIO, CFO, CISO, COO) plus the CMO and Head of Compliance. The CISO reports **directly to the CEO** (independent of IT) with a dotted line to the board audit committee.
:::

## Reporting lines & accountability

| Executive | Reports to | Direct remit |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|
| **Dr Amina Chowdhury** — CTO | CEO | Technology strategy & architecture; CSMP platform direction |
| **Mark Gonzalez** — CIO | CEO | IT operations, cloud infrastructure, internal platforms, engineering |
| **Aisha Rahman** — CFO | CEO | Finance, budgeting, financial risk & ROI |
| **Sophia Martines** — CISO | CEO (dotted line to board audit committee) | Security strategy, governance, risk & compliance oversight |
| **Sarah Thompson** — COO | CEO | Service delivery, customer support, HR, operational efficiency |
| **Lisa Chen** — CMO | CEO | Marketing & brand |
| **Emily Chen** — Head of Compliance | CEO (partners with CISO) | Regulatory compliance, internal & external audit liaison |

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
**Segregation-of-duties note for auditors.** The CISO is **independent of the CIO/CTO** (direct CEO line), which is the intended control design. The Head of Compliance also reports to the CEO but operationally partners with the CISO — auditors should confirm this collaboration is documented, not assumed.
:::

*Currency: AUD. ~47 staff headcount (note: some internal sources cite a higher figure — this variance is a known documentation inconsistency). Document reviewed 29-06-2026.*
